text:
The Ann–Ben block is consecutive, with Cara before Elif before Ann before Hana, and Gus at least three slots after Ann. The only block that also keeps Dev at least three slots from Ann, Ben, Cara, and Gus (and before Gus) is Ann in 6 and Ben in 7, which forces Gus into 9 and Hana into 8.

Elif is the only remaining person who can sit in 5. Dev must then be in 1, Finn in 2 (the only slot at least three from both Ben and Elif), Ivo in 3, and Cara in 4. Every other placement breaks a distance or order constraint. Finn in 3 and Ivo in 2 puts Elif and Finn only two slots apart.
